mapper.sql: AND h.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT visible_homework.id FROM edu_homework visible_homework JOIN edu_class visible_class ON visible_class.id = visible_homework.class_id AND visible_class.deleted = 0 AND visible_class.status = 0 JOIN capacity_course visible_course ON visible_course.id = visible_homework.course_id AND visible_course.deleted = 0 AND visible_course.status = 0 JOIN edu_class_course visible_binding ON visible_binding.class_id = visible_homework.class_id AND visible_binding.course_id = visible_homework.course_id AND visible_binding.deleted = 0 AND visible_binding.status = 0 WHERE visible_homework.deleted = 0 AND visible_homework.status IN (1, 2) AND (TRIM(COALESCE(visible_homework.semester_name, '')) = '' OR TRIM(COALESCE(visible_binding.semester_name, '')) = '' OR TRIM(visible_binding.semester_name) = TRIM(visible_homework.semester_name)))

AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_class visible_class JOIN capacity_course visible_course ON visible_course.id = h.course_id AND visible_course.deleted = 0 AND visible_course.status = 0 JOIN edu_class_course visible_binding ON visible_binding.class_id = h.class_id AND visible_binding.course_id = h.course_id AND visible_binding.deleted = 0 AND visible_binding.status = 0 WHERE visible_class.id = h.class_id AND visible_class.deleted = 0 AND visible_class.status = 0 AND (TRIM(COALESCE(h.semester_name, '')) = '' OR TRIM(COALESCE(visible_binding.semester_name, '')) = '' OR TRIM(visible_binding.semester_name) = TRIM(h.semester_name)))

AND h.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT visible_homework.id FROM edu_homework visible_homework JOIN edu_class visible_class ON visible_class.id = visible_homework.class_id AND visible_class.deleted = 0 JOIN capacity_course visible_course ON visible_course.id = visible_homework.course_id AND visible_course.deleted = 0 JOIN edu_class_course visible_binding ON visible_binding.class_id = visible_homework.class_id AND visible_binding.course_id = visible_homework.course_id AND visible_binding.deleted = 0 WHERE visible_homework.deleted = 0 AND visible_homework.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND (TRIM(COALESCE(visible_homework.semester_name, '')) = '' OR TRIM(COALESCE(visible_binding.semester_name, '')) = '' OR TRIM(visible_binding.semester_name) = TRIM(visible_homework.semester_name)))

AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_class visible_class JOIN capacity_course visible_course ON visible_course.id = h.course_id AND visible_course.deleted = 0 JOIN edu_class_course visible_binding ON visible_binding.class_id = h.class_id AND visible_binding.course_id = h.course_id AND visible_binding.deleted = 0 WHERE visible_class.id = h.class_id AND visible_class.deleted = 0 AND (TRIM(COALESCE(h.semester_name, '')) = '' OR TRIM(COALESCE(visible_binding.semester_name, '')) = '' OR TRIM(visible_binding.semester_name) = TRIM(h.semester_name)))

sql.if: AND h.teacher_id = #{claimTeacherId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_class_course claim_binding WHERE claim_binding.course_id = h.course_id AND claim_binding.class_id = h.class_id AND claim_binding.deleted = 0 AND claim_binding.status = 0 AND claim_binding.claim_teacher_id = #{claimTeacherId} AND (TRIM(COALESCE(h.semester_name, '')) = '' OR TRIM(COALESCE(claim_binding.semester_name, '')) = '' OR TRIM(claim_binding.semester_name) = TRIM(h.semester_name)))

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM capacity_course WHERE deleted = 0 AND is_public_course = 0 AND public_audit_status = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalRecords, SUM(CASE WHEN hr.score < h.pass_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unqualifiedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN hr.score >= h.pass_score AND hr.score < GREATEST(h.pass_score, h.score * #{goodRatio}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS qualifiedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN hr.score >= GREATEST(h.pass_score, h.score * #{goodRatio}) AND hr.score < GREATEST(GREATEST(h.pass_score, h.score * #{goodRatio}), h.score * #{excellentRatio}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS goodCount, SUM(CASE WHEN hr.score >= GREATEST(GREATEST(h.pass_score, h.score * #{goodRatio}), h.score * #{excellentRatio}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS excellentCount FROM edu_homework_record hr
JOIN ( SELECT h.id, h.course_id, h.class_id, h.teacher_id, h.semester_name, h.status, h.pass_score, h.score FROM edu_homework h WHERE h.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND h.deleted = 0 AND h.status IN (1, 2, 3) UNION ALL SELECT owned.id, owned.course_id, owned.class_id, owned.teacher_id, owned.semester_name, owned.status, owned.pass_score, owned.score FROM capacity_course owner_course JOIN edu_homework owned ON owned.course_id = owner_course.id AND owned.deleted = 0 AND owned.status IN (1, 2, 3) WHERE owner_course.teacher_Id = #{teacherId} AND owner_course.is_public_course = 0 AND owner_course.deleted = 0 AND (owned.teacher_id IS NULL OR owned.teacher_id != #{teacherId}) ) h ON hr.homework_id = h.id
JOIN edu_homework h ON hr.homework_id = h.id AND h.deleted = 0 AND h.status IN (1, 2, 3)
WHERE hr.deleted = 0 AND hr.status = 2 AND h.status IN (1, 2, 3)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_course scope_course WHERE scope_course.id = h.course_id AND scope_course.deleted = 0 AND ((scope_course.is_public_course = 0 AND (scope_course.teacher_Id = #{teacherId} OR (h.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_class_course claim_binding WHERE claim_binding.course_id = h.course_id AND claim_binding.class_id = h.class_id AND claim_binding.deleted = 0 AND claim_binding.status = 0 AND claim_binding.claim_teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND (TRIM(COALESCE(h.semester_name, '')) = '' OR TRIM(COALESCE(claim_binding.semester_name, '')) = '' OR TRIM(claim_binding.semester_name) = TRIM(h.semester_name)))))) OR ((scope_course.is_public_course IS NULL OR scope_course.is_public_course != 0) AND h.teacher_id = #{teacherId})))
AND h.class_id IN #{cid}
AND h.course_id = #{courseId}
AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(h.semester_name), ''), (SELECT TRIM(binding.semester_name) FROM edu_class_course binding WHERE binding.class_id = h.class_id AND binding.course_id = h.course_id AND binding.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1)) LIKE CONCAT(#{academicYear}, '-', #{academicYear} + 1, '%')

SELECT DISTINCT cc.id AS id, cc.course_name AS name FROM capacity_course cc WHERE cc.deleted = 0
AND (cc.teacher_Id = #{teacherId} OR ((cc.is_public_course IS NULL OR cc.is_public_course != 0) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_course_member team WHERE team.course_id = cc.id AND team.user_id = #{teacherId} AND team.deleted = 0)) OR (cc.is_public_course = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_class_course claim_binding WHERE claim_binding.course_id = cc.id AND claim_binding.claim_teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND claim_binding.deleted = 0 AND claim_binding.status = 0)))
ORDER BY cc.course_name

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_class ec JOIN edu_class_course binding ON binding.class_id = ec.id AND binding.deleted = 0 JOIN capacity_course c ON c.id = binding.course_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE ec.id = #{classId} AND ec.deleted = 0 AND ((c.is_public_course = 0 AND (c.teacher_Id = #{teacherId} OR (binding.status = 0 AND binding.claim_teacher_id = #{teacherId}))) OR ((c.is_public_course IS NULL OR c.is_public_course != 0) AND (c.teacher_Id = #{teacherId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_course_member team WHERE team.course_id = c.id AND team.user_id = #{teacherId} AND team.deleted = 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_class_course_assistant assistant WHERE assistant.class_course_id = binding.id AND assistant.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND assistant.deleted = 0)))))

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_class ec JOIN edu_class_course binding ON binding.class_id = ec.id AND binding.deleted = 0 JOIN capacity_course c ON c.id = binding.course_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE c.id = #{courseId} AND ec.deleted = 0 AND (c.is_public_course IS NULL OR c.is_public_course != 0) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_class_course_assistant assistant WHERE assistant.class_course_id = binding.id AND assistant.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND assistant.deleted = 0))

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_class ec JOIN edu_class_course binding ON binding.class_id = ec.id AND binding.deleted = 0 JOIN capacity_course c ON c.id = binding.course_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE ec.id = #{classId} AND c.id = #{courseId} AND ec.deleted = 0)
mapper.sql: FROM edu_homework_record hr JOIN edu_homework h ON h.id = hr.homework_id AND h.deleted = 0 AND h.status IN (1, 2, 3) JOIN system_users su ON hr.student_id = su.id AND su.deleted = 0 WHERE hr.deleted = 0 AND hr.status = 2
mapper.select:
SELECT hr.student_id AS studentId, su.nickname AS studentName, hr.score
AND hr.homework_id = #{homeworkId} ORDER BY hr.score DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT hr.student_id AS studentId, su.nickname AS studentName, hr.score FROM edu_homework_record hr JOIN edu_homework h ON h.id = hr.homework_id AND h.deleted = 0 AND h.status IN (1, 2, 3) JOIN system_users su ON hr.student_id = su.id AND su.deleted = 0 WHERE hr.deleted = 0 AND hr.status = 2 AND hr.homework_id = #{homeworkId} ORDER BY hr.score ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_users WHERE user_type = 2 AND deleted = 0 AND status = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_users WHERE user_type = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND status = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM capacity_course WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_homework h WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.status IN (1, 2)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_homework_record hr JOIN edu_homework h ON h.id = hr.homework_id AND h.deleted = 0 AND h.status IN (1, 2) WHERE hr.deleted = 0 AND hr.status IN (1, 2, 4) AND hr.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY)
AND h.teacher_id = #{teacherId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_homework_record hr JOIN edu_homework h ON h.id = hr.homework_id AND h.deleted = 0 AND h.status IN (1, 2) WHERE hr.deleted = 0 AND hr.status IN (1, 4)
AND h.teacher_id = #{teacherId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_homework_record hr JOIN edu_homework h ON h.id = hr.homework_id AND h.deleted = 0 AND h.status IN (1, 2) WHERE hr.deleted = 0 AND hr.status = 2 AND hr.score IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_homework_ai_review ar WHERE ar.homework_record_id = hr.id AND ar.deleted = 0 AND ar.status IN (2, 4, 5))

SELECT COALESCE(SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_message m WHERE m.class_id = scope.class_id AND m.course_id = scope.course_id AND m.type = 0 AND m.read_status = 0 AND m.deleted = 0)), 0) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT cc.class_id, cc.course_id FROM edu_class_course cc JOIN capacity_course c ON c.id = cc.course_id AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 0 JOIN edu_class ec ON ec.id = cc.class_id AND ec.deleted = 0 AND ec.status = 0 WHERE cc.deleted = 0 AND cc.status = 0 AND ((c.is_public_course = 0 AND (cc.claim_teacher_id = #{teacherId} OR (cc.claim_teacher_id IS NULL AND c.teacher_Id = #{teacherId}))) OR ((c.is_public_course IS NULL OR c.is_public_course != 0) AND (c.teacher_Id = #{teacherId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_course_member team WHERE team.course_id = c.id AND team.user_id = #{teacherId} AND team.deleted = 0))) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_class_course_assistant assistant WHERE assistant.class_course_id = cc.id AND assistant.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND assistant.deleted = 0))) scope

SELECT h.id AS homeworkId, h.homework_name AS homeworkName, h.status, h.create_time AS createTime, cc.course_name AS courseName FROM edu_homework h JOIN capacity_course cc ON h.course_id = cc.id AND cc.deleted = 0 AND cc.status = 0 WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.status IN (1, 2) AND h.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY h.create_time DESC LIMIT 5
